candidate.title: Unbounded numbering level causes billions of resolver iterations
candidate.originalEvidence: Baseline: src/convert/mod.rs:12711-12714 accepts w:ilvl u32; definitions 6619-6621. Numbering::resolve_ilvl scans (0..ilvl).rev().find at 5529-5531; next_marker fills counters 0..resolved at 5610-5629. ilvl=4000000000 yields billions of probes. Markdown clamps ilvl to8.
